Norvex Integrated Enterprises Ltd · Operations console

Money, margin and momentum — at a glance.

Every figure on the admin dashboard is computed from the live order book: revenue, cost of goods, gross profit, margin, cash collected, what is still owed, and what is still pending. Built as a dependency-free SVG chart kit, so it runs inside the single-file build with no CDN, no network and no jank.
